Introduction

Mei Qi is a Chinese singer, dancer, and actress under Yue Hua Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl group WJSN and the Chinese project girl group Rocket Girls 101.

Mei Qi debuted as a member of WJSN on February 25, 2016, with the mini album "WOULD YOU LIKE?". In the group's concept, she represented the Libra sign. On March 3, 2023, after five years of inactivity with the group, it was announced that Mei Qi didn't renew her contract with Starship Entertainment and would officially leave WJSN to pursue solo activities in China.

Mei Qi, alongside fellow WJSN member Xuan Yi, joined Produce 101 China in 2018, where she ended up ranking 1st place overall, becoming a member of the final group, Rocket Girls 101. She debuted with the group on June 23, 2018, with the single "Collide". She was active with the group until its disbandment on June 23, 2020.

Mei Qi made her Chinese solo debut on January 15, 2019, releasing the song "Helios" for the movie "The Wandering Earth". She later released the EP 'Jiang' on April 23, 2019, which became the fastest selling digital album on QQ Music in 2019, with over 1 million digital sales within the first twenty minutes of the album's release.

Still in 2019, she also debuted as an actress in the movie 'Autumn Fairy Tale', as a supporting character. She starred for the first time as a main lead in the 2019 dance movie, 'Step Up: Year of the Dance' and in the Wuxia film 'Jade Dynasty'.
